note: Placeholder coefficients, NOT a fitted curve. While calibrated=false (uncompressed/RealSense) or calibrated_rg=false (compressed/webcam) the spo2 module reports a trend only for that mode and forces confidence to near zero. Fit real coefficients against a reference pulse oximeter with tools/spo2_calibrate.py, which rewrites this file with the fitted A/B (or A_rg/B_rg), the device id, and an ISO-8601 fitted_at.
